AppUserLogins
# Id Created Disconnected App User Login Id App User First Name App User Last Name App User Admin Host Name Location Computer Name Total Memory Free Memory
<%=#counter appUserLogins, '4R,'%> <%=connectionId, '5R,'%> <%=created, '15L.'%> <%=disconnected, '15L.'%> <%=appUser.loginId, '50L.'%> <%=appUser.firstName, '50L.'%> <%=appUser.lastName, '50L.'%> <%=appUser.admin, '5L.'%> <%=hostName, '50L.'%> <%=location, '50L.'%> <%=computerName, '12L.'%> <%=totalMemory, '5R,'%> <%=freeMemory, '5R,'%>
 
<%=foreach applicationTypes%> <%=end%>
ApplicationTypes
# Id Abbrev Name Port HTTP HTTPS
<%=#counter applicationTypes, '4R,'%> <%=id, '6R,'%> <%=abbrevName, '6L.'%> <%=name, '40L.'%> <%=clientPort, '#'%> <%=httpPort, '#'%> <%=httpsPort, '#'%>
 
<%=foreach mergeServerApplications%> <%=end%>
MergeServerApplications
